description: Standalone Utah retained normalized release adoption with full PDF semantic verification and durable linked application receipts. No source download, rebuild or refresh.
redirect_policy: No network requests. Acquire means reuse and replay of the pinned retained source, not download.
retry: No automatic retry, refetch or restart. Unknown ownership locks require inspection; never stolen.
checkpoint: Durable start before local processing, semantic verified normalized reference, terminal receipt last. Published child evidence is preserved on failure.
idempotency: Immutable UUID app receipts adopt the exact pinned existing normalized release. No source redownload, duplicate normalization, overwrite or national pointer changes.
cancellation: Abort and deadline drain the guarded PDF subprocess before terminal persistence and owned lock release. Crash remnants require inspection, not automatic recovery.
retention_profile: Internal immutable retained source and linked normalized evidence. App execution does not assert historical app acquisition, current operations, physical sites, public export, scheduled refresh or national integration.
